## System Overview
A multi-scale verification suite validating an extended six-dimensional semiclassical configuration manifold M6 ~= M4 x (R+ x S1). The architecture addresses the cosmological Hubble tension via an isolated chameleon transient phase without unphysical late-time vacuum bleeding into dark matter sectors.

- Reconciled Local Expansion Scale (H0): 74.39 km/s/Mpc
- Early Acoustic Reconciled Horizon Baseline: 67.95 km/s/Mpc

## Scale-Based Computational Directory Mapping
The private algorithmic engine core (torsional-action-source-code) is organized by physical boundaries:
- /cosmology : Handles macro-scale density profiles, expansion integrands, and high-z quantum noise filters.
- /astrophysics : Governs lookback wave propagation trajectories, heliopause screening, and galactic density fields.
- /quantum_lab : Tracks sub-micron vacuum force scaling, chameleon spatial curves, and neutron interferometry phases.
- /hardware_sim : Simulates condensed matter thermal noise filters, 32-qubit state routing, and SQUID loop voltage curves.

Source scripts are privately archived and cryptographically notarized using SHA-256 digital hashes via OpenTimestamps. Access exception clearances are restricted strictly to validated ORCID researcher credentials.
